responsibility: Solves the collected lexical region constraint graph into concrete values for region variables and reports unsatisfied subregion, generic-bound, and universe-conflict errors after fixed-point propagation and verification.
same_name_distinction: This is the execution-phase solver for lexical region inference. Given `VarInfos` and `RegionConstraintData`, it propagates the region graph into `LexicalRegionResolutions` and produces `RegionResolutionError`s, whereas `region_constraints/mod.rs` owns and mutates the collected constraints and `outlives/mod.rs` orchestrates when solving happens and how results are stored back on `InferCtxt`.
